prompt: Write a one-star review of Yellowstone from a driver whose schedule was disrupted by bison.
response:
**★☆☆☆☆ RUINED MY ENTIRE ITINERARY. Unacceptable traffic management!**

If I could give zero stars, I would. 

I am a highly organized traveler. I had a meticulously planned spreadsheet for our Yellowstone trip: 9:00 AM at the Grand Prismatic, 11:30 AM lunch reservation at the Lodge, and 1:00 PM for Old Faithful. It was foolproof. Enter: the local wildlife.

Somewhere near Hayden Valley, we came to a dead, grinding halt. Was it construction? An accident? No. It was a herd of giant, overgrown, fuzzy cows walking down the dead center of the highway at one mile per hour. 

We were stuck in a "bison jam" for TWO HOURS. Two. Whole. Hours. These animals have thousands and thousands of acres of open plains to walk on, but for some reason, the park allows them to just loiter on the only paved road. To make matters worse, nobody tried to move them along! The park rangers just sat there in their SUVs watching. Excuse me? You work here! Beep your horn! Do your job and manage the traffic!

Meanwhile, every other driver decided to treat this massive inconvenience like a red-carpet event, rolling down their windows and holding up the line even further to take terrible iPad photos. 

Because of these oblivious animals, I completely missed my lunch reservation and we only saw the tail-end of the geyser erupting. If you actually value your time and have a schedule to keep, skip Yellowstone. Go to a zoo where the animals actually stay in their designated areas and don't hold humanity hostage. Ridiculous.
